description: Complete a sign-in started by login, using the 'code' value the user copied from the browser address bar. On success the user can place orders from that restaurant.

clientId.description: clientId of the restaurant being signed in to. Omit if only one sign-in is in progress.

code.description: The code value copied from the redirect URL after signing in.

label.description: Optional label for this account, e.g. 'work' or 'personal'. Defaults to the email address on the account.

name: submit_login_code
title: Finish signing in
